import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        long mod = 998244353;
        int minNk = Math.min(n, k);
        long[] dp = new long[minNk + 1];
        dp[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = minNk; j >= 1; j--) {
                dp[j] = (dp[j] * j % mod + dp[j - 1] * (n - j + 1) % mod) % mod;
            }
            dp[0] = 0; // after first iteration, dp[0] becomes 0 because no way to have 0 distinct elements with i>0? Actually dp[0] should remain 0 for i>0, but we set it to 0 explicitly.
        }
        long invm = modExp(m, mod - 2, mod);
        long res = 0;
        long prob = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= minNk; i++) {
            res = (res + dp[i] * prob % mod) % mod;
            prob = prob * invm % mod;
        }
        System.out.println(res);
        sc.close();
    }

    static long modExp(long x, long y, long mod) {
        long res = 1;
        while (y > 0) {
            if ((y & 1) == 1) res = res * x % mod;
            x = x * x % mod;
            y >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
}

        long invm = modExp(m, mod - 2, mod);

        int n = in.nextInt();
        int m = in.nextInt();
        int k = in.nextInt();

        long[][] dp = new long[k + 1][lim + 1];
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= lim; j++) {
                dp[i][j] = (dp[i - 1][j] * j % mod + dp[i - 1][j - 1] * (n - j + 1) % mod) % mod;
            }
        }
        long invm = modPow(m, mod - 2, mod);
        long res = 0;
        long[] pow = new long[lim + 1];
        pow[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= lim; i++) {
            pow[i] = pow[i - 1] * invm % mod;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= lim; i++) {
            res = (res + dp[k][i] * pow[i] % mod) % mod;
        }
        out.println(res);
        out.close();
    }

    static long modPow(long a, long e, long mod) {
        long r = 1;
        while (e > 0) {
            if ((e & 1) == 1) r = r * a % mod;
            a = a * a % mod;
            e >>= 1;
        }
        return r;
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private InputStream stream;
        private byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
        private int curChar;
        private int numChars;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        public int read() {
            if (numChars == -1) throw new RuntimeException();
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try {
                    numChars = stream.read(buf);
                } catch (IOException e) {
                    throw new RuntimeException(e);
                }
                if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[curChar++];
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            int c = read();
            while (c <= ' ') c = read();
            int sgn = 1;
            if (c == '-') { sgn = -1; c = read(); }
            int res = 0;
            do {
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw new RuntimeException();
                res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
                c = read();
            } while (c > ' ');
            return res * sgn;
        }
    }
}

        long[] dp0 = new long[lim + 1];
        long[] dp1 = new long[lim + 1];
        dp0[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= k; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= lim; j++) {
                long val = 0;
                if (j > 0) val = (val + dp0[j - 1] * (n - j + 1) % mod) % mod;
                val = (val + dp0[j] * j % mod) % mod;
                dp1[j] = val;
            }
            long[] tmp = dp0;
            dp0 = dp1;
            dp1 = tmp;
        }
        long invm = modExp(m, mod - 2, mod);
        long res = 0;
        long prob = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i <= lim; i++) {
            res = (res + dp0[i] * prob % mod) % mod;
            prob = prob * invm % mod;
        }
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        out.println(res);
        out.close();
    }

    static long modExp(long x, long y, long mod) {
        if (y == 0) return 1;
        if (y == 1) return x;
        long ret = modExp(x, y >> 1, mod);
        ret = ret * ret % mod;
        if ((y & 1) == 1) ret = ret * x % mod;
        return ret;
    }

    static int parseInt(String s, int start) {
        int res = 0;
        while (start < s.length() && s.charAt(start) >= '0' && s.charAt(start) <= '9') {
            res = res * 10 + (s.charAt(start) - '0');
            start++;
        }
        return res;
    }

    static int nextSpace(String s, int start) {
        while (start < s.length() && s.charAt(start) != ' ') start++;
        return start;
    }
